nodes.content: Develop knowledge editing that propagates temporally scoped factual changes through multi-hop reasoning without overwriting valid historical knowledge.
requirements: Achieve at least 90% accuracy on held-out multi-hop questions requiring temporally scoped edited facts.
Keep historical and unrelated factual accuracy within one percentage point of the unedited model.

nodes.content: Attach interval-indexed fact patches to a frozen model; gate time-filtered multi-hop retrieval by edited entities while retaining historical versions.
How can interval-indexed retrieval reject multi-hop paths with incompatible validity windows without suppressing valid historical paths?
Question-time-conditioned interval intersection will reach ≥90% TemporalHop multi-hop accuracy while limiting historical accuracy loss to ≤1 percentage point.
Construct TemporalHop dated two- and three-hop edits; compare interval-intersection versus recency-only routing on edited, historical, and unrelated accuracy.
Compare interval-intersection and recency-only routing on TemporalHop v1’s 1,200 held-out questions, measuring edited multi-hop, historical, and unrelated accuracy.
TemporalHop v1: interval routing scored 92% edited versus 76% recency-only; historical/unrelated accuracy dropped 0.4/0.2 percentage points versus baseline.
Adopt interval-intersection routing over recency-only: TemporalHop v1 exceeds 90% edited accuracy with under one-point historical and unrelated losses.
Following interval-routing adoption, construct TemporalHop v2 boundary-date and overlapping-edit splits; audit edited, historical, and unrelated accuracy.
Build TemporalHop v2’s 400 boundary-date and 400 overlapping-edit questions; score interval routing’s edited, historical, and unrelated accuracy.
TemporalHop v2 audit bundle: 800 labeled questions; interval-routing accuracy 83% boundary, 89% overlapping; historical/unrelated losses 0.6/0.3 points versus baseline.
Audit 100 TemporalHop v2 errors for endpoint conventions, conflicting edits, and annotation defects to assess the bundle’s accuracy gaps.
Of 100 TemporalHop v2 errors, 58 involved patch endpoints, 27 overlap precedence, and 15 labels; historical accuracy lost 0.6 points.
Half-open intervals and latest-effective-date precedence should yield ≥90% accuracy on both TemporalHop v2 splits with ≤1-point historical/unrelated losses.
Implement half-open intervals and latest-effective-date precedence; evaluate both TemporalHop v2 splits for edited, historical, and unrelated accuracy.
TemporalHop v2: boundary accuracy rose to 93%, but overlapping-edit accuracy remained 89%; historical/unrelated losses stayed 0.6/0.3 points.
Replace latest-date-only precedence with provenance-aware supersession; half-open intervals should reach ≥90% on both v2 splits with ≤1-point historical/unrelated losses.
Implement explicit patch-supersession links; compare provenance-aware versus latest-date routing on both TemporalHop v2 splits and historical/unrelated controls.
TemporalHop v2: provenance routing reached 94% boundary and 92% overlap, but historical/unrelated accuracy lost 1.3/0.3 points.
Onset-gated supersession should retain ≥90% accuracy on both v2 splits while restoring pre-edit history and limiting historical/unrelated losses ≤1 point.
Gate supersession at each replacement’s onset; evaluate TemporalHop v2 splits and pre-edit historical/unrelated controls against the frozen baseline.
TemporalHop v2: onset gating scored 94% boundary, 92% overlap; historical/unrelated accuracy lost 1.2/0.3 points versus baseline.
Version-pin historical paths while retaining onset-gated supersession; target ≥90% on both v2 splits and ≤1-point historical/unrelated losses.
Implement query-time version pinning for historical paths; rerun TemporalHop v2 splits and historical/unrelated controls against onset-gated routing.
TemporalHop v2: version pinning scored 94% boundary and 92% overlap, but historical/unrelated losses remained 1.1/0.3 points.
Audit 100 version-pinned historical errors, stratified by query date, to test whether path-version pinning preserves pre-edit facts.
Among 100 version-pinned historical errors, 71 involved date parsing; onset-only routing made 19 additional pre-edit substitutions.
Date normalization before version pinning should preserve ≥90% accuracy on both v2 splits and cap historical/unrelated losses at ≤1 point.
Normalize explicit dates and year-only queries to canonical intervals, then rerun version-pinned TemporalHop v2 and historical/unrelated controls.
Implement ISO-date and year-interval parsing before version pinning; rescore TemporalHop v2 splits and historical/unrelated controls against baseline.
TemporalHop v2: date normalization preserved 94% boundary and 92% overlap accuracy; historical/unrelated losses were 0.7/0.3 points versus baseline.
Adopt date-normalized version pinning: parsing errors dominated the audit; historical loss fell from 1.1 to 0.7 points.
Train sparse, date-gated low-rank adapters on multi-hop entailment chains; route historical queries through the frozen base model.
Can date-gated adapters generalize edits to unseen three-hop questions without activating on historically valid queries?
Training rank-8 adapters on dated entailment chains will score ≥90% unseen three-hop accuracy with ≤1-point historical/unrelated losses.
Train rank-8 date-gated adapters on TemporalHop v1 two-hop chains; test unseen three-hop questions and historical/unrelated controls.
TemporalHop v1 unseen three-hop accuracy reached 86%; historical/unrelated accuracy fell 0.8/0.4 points versus frozen baseline.
Adding contrastive historical negatives to rank-8 adapter training should reach ≥90% unseen three-hop accuracy with ≤1-point preservation losses.
Retrain date-gated rank-8 adapters with 2:1 contrastive historical negatives; evaluate unseen three-hop accuracy and historical/unrelated losses.
TemporalHop v1 unseen three-hop accuracy rose from 86% to 91%; historical/unrelated losses were 0.6/0.4 points versus baseline.
Apply timestamp-conditioned activation steering at entity–relation binding layers using contrastive edited/historical pairs, leaving model weights frozen.
Can timestamp-conditioned steering persist across unseen multi-hop paraphrases without changing historical answers or unrelated entity–relation bindings?
Locate entity–relation binding layers, fit date-conditioned contrastive steering vectors, and benchmark TemporalHop unseen paraphrases plus historical/unrelated controls.
Probe 12 transformer layers for entity–relation binding; fit time-gated steering vectors on 600 edited/historical contrastive pairs.
TimeSteer v1 checkpoint: layer-8 and layer-9 steering vectors, date gates, and 600 labeled edited/historical training pairs.
Test TimeSteer v1 on TemporalHop’s 500 unseen multi-hop paraphrases plus historical/unrelated controls against frozen-base accuracy.
TimeSteer v1 scored 91% on 500 unseen multi-hop paraphrases; historical/unrelated accuracy losses were 0.8/0.5 points versus frozen base.
Advance TimeSteer to cross-method boundary-date evaluation: its paraphrase scores meet targets, adapters remain viable, and retrieval audits exposed endpoint risks.
